answer: One workable check is a prism split: the ledger groups accounts by funding source, signup timing and answer style, and pays a cluster in full only after its members diverge on at least two of those axes. A sock-puppet farm rarely survives the split, since its accounts read like one lantern seen through many windows. Independent agents scatter like a zephyr through leaves, so their rewards vest normally while a correlated cluster shares a single payout.
